watch.summary: The creator hysterically reacts and hypes up pro Valorant player Cryo getting multiple kills in an esports match.

beats.what: Cryo scores a kill, streamer screams 'Get him out of here!'
Cryo lands another kill and streamer jumps up screaming again
Cryo gets another sniper hit and streamer yells 'He's awake!'
Cryo eliminates another opponent as streamer screams 'Get him out of here!'

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The clip relies entirely on screaming energy and hype over pro Valorant gameplay rather than deliberate comedic structure. Without an interest in esports or the streamer, the loud screaming offers little humor to an outside viewer.
